Facility Inventory & Condition Assessmen.justification: Comprehensive district-wide inventory including detailed building sizes, ages, portables, and specialized spaces; robust condition assessment with detailed cost analysis and sustainability modeling linking condition to long-term capital planning (Pages 6-44).

Enrollment & Capacity Planning.justification: Detailed enrollment projections with capacity utilization data by site and classroom; explicit connection of enrollment to facility capacity and potential for accommodating additional students; clear strategies for space use and capacity (Pages 5-10, 12, 27-30).

Educational Alignment.justification: Plan references educational goals and specifications, including alignment of facilities with educational programs and standards; mentions technology integration and program needs but lacks full integration of facility projects directly tied to educational goals (Pages 3-5, 10).

Outdoor Spaces & Greening.justification: No mention or discussion of outdoor greening, shade, or environmental benefits of outdoor spaces; outdoor areas described only as play courts, fields, and parking without greening strategies (Pages 11-44).

Climate Risk & Mitigation.justification: No mention of climate risks, climate readiness, or mitigation strategies related to climate change impacts in the plan; emergency preparedness not linked to climate (Entire document).

Energy Efficiency & Resilience.justification: Includes energy efficiency strategies such as LED lighting upgrades and HVAC improvements funded by Prop 39; references energy surveys and some resilience goals but lacks comprehensive energy resilience or electrification plan (Pages 14, 30).

Financial Plan & Capital Strategy.justification: Detailed 5-year Capital Improvement Plan with itemized cost estimates, prioritization framework, and funding sources including Prop 39 and bonds; includes contingency and escalation assumptions and aligns financial planning with facility needs (Pages 9-19, 29-31).
